audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagrees with its own whys in four slots: Levels 4-5 read Gwen while the why calls it Kennen's best burst window, Level 6 reads Kennen while both the why and the spike say Gwen flips the lane there, and 2+ items reads Gwen while the why hands the game to his AoE stun.
audit.why: Kennen is a ranged energy kiter who owns levels 1-5 and reclaims the game in 5v5s; Gwen's window is level 6 through her first item, exactly as the prose already says.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Kennen / Skill / Skill / Kennen / Gwen / Gwen / Kennen in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] covers Levels 4-5 but describes a Q into W into R burst — Slicing Maelstrom does not exist before level 6.
audit.why: Slicing Maelstrom is Kennen's ultimate. At levels 4-5 his stun comes from Thundering Shuriken plus Electrical Surge and autos, not from R.
audit.corrected: whys[3] now describes the three-Mark stun he actually has at 4-5, and the level-6 spike is where R enters.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldowns anywhere, so 'bait his R' and 'bait Lightning Rush' had no clock.
audit.why: Thundering Shuriken is 7s at rank 1, Electrical Surge 13s, Lightning Rush 10s, and Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s at every rank — that flat 120 is why the post-ult window is the whole matchup.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns added to whys, early/mid/late and the spike text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every prose field is written in first person ('I', 'my', 'me') instead of the site's second-person coaching voice.
audit.why: The rest of the site addresses the reader as 'you'; this matchup reads as a diary.
audit.corrected: early, mid, late and all seven whys converted to second person at the same length.

edits.after: No mist, no E — Kennen sits at range and pokes you with Thundering Shuriken (Q, 7s at rank 1) while his autos stack Mark of the Storm, and you walk up for every last-hit.

edits.before: He keeps Q poke and auto-empowered W (Electrical Surge) up and keeps kiting; I still have no untargetability and can't punish his spacing, so the chip and Mark stacks keep building.
edits.after: He keeps Thundering Shuriken and auto-empowered Electrical Surge (W, 13s) up and keeps kiting; you still have no untargetability and cannot punish his spacing, so chip and Mark stacks build.

edits.before: With Q and E online I can poke-and-reset and threaten a trade if he steps up, but his ranged Thundering Shuriken still trades even — it's a coin flip on who commits first.
edits.after: With Q and E online you can poke-and-reset and threaten a trade if he steps up, but his ranged Thundering Shuriken still trades even — it is a coin flip on who commits first.

edits.before: Kennen owns these levels and it's pure damage control, not trading. His Q (Thundering Shuriken) outranges everything I have, and his autos stack Mark of the Storm toward a stun while I have no W untargetability and no E dash at 1 — I'm just a melee eating poke every time I step for a creep. Don't throw my cone Q (Snip Snip!) at a kiter who'll never sit in it; last-hit at the tip and accept the chip. My out is that Thousand Cuts plus my ability healing means his energy poke can't actually out-DPS my sustain if I bank levels, so I farm to 6 and refuse to int into a three-stack stun.
edits.after: Kennen owns these levels and it is damage control, not trading. Thundering Shuriken (Q, 7s at rank 1) outranges everything you have, and his autos stack Mark of the Storm toward a stun while you have no mist and no dash at 1 — you are a melee eating poke on every creep. Do not throw the Snip Snip! cone at a kiter who will never sit in it; last-hit at the tip and accept the chip. Your out is that A Thousand Cuts plus your ability healing means his energy poke cannot out-DPS your sustain if you bank levels, so farm to 6 and refuse to int into a three-stack stun.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are still his — a pre-mist melee getting kited, and a clean Q into W (Electrical Surge) detonating three Mark stacks into R can chunk me out of lane. At 6 it flips: Needlework plus my whole kit means I E-dash in, drop Hallowed Mist exactly as his stun or Lightning Rush (E) lands so I go untargetable through the follow-up, and Snip Snip him while he's stuck in melee. Bait the R — once his ult and dash are down he has no disengage, and percent-max-HP Q plus Thousand Cuts on-hits grind him out of the extended fight he can't kite away from.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are still his — a pre-mist melee getting kited, and a clean Thundering Shuriken into Electrical Surge (W, 13s) detonates three Marks and chunks you out of lane. At 6 it flips: E-dash in, drop Hallowed Mist exactly as his stun or Lightning Rush (E, 10s) lands so you go untargetable through the follow-up, and Snip Snip him while he is stuck in melee. Bait Slicing Maelstrom — with a flat 120-second ult and his dash down he has no disengage, and %-max-HP Q plus Thousand Cuts on-hits grind out the fight he cannot kite away from.

edits.before: My item spike at Riftmaker/Nashor's is real — with Grievous up I can E-gap onto a squishy Kennen and burst him with percent-HP Snip plus the true-damage center snip before Lightning Rush kites out, so I want to close on that mid-game window. But honestly, late he reclaims it: his R (Slicing Maelstrom) is an AOE stun on a passive-move-speed kite kit, so in any 5v5 he peels me, resets the spacing, and denies the 1v1 I'm built to win. Force the all-in on his R and E cooldowns before teamfights make his range and stun matter more than my dueling.
edits.after: Your Riftmaker/Nashor's spike is real — with Grievous up you E-gap onto a squishy Kennen and burst him with %-HP Snip plus the true-damage center before Lightning Rush (E, 10s) kites out, so close on that mid-game window. Late he reclaims it: Slicing Maelstrom is an AoE stun on a passive-move-speed kite kit, so in a 5v5 he peels you, resets the spacing, and denies the 1v1 you are built to win. Force the all-in while his R's flat 120 seconds and his E are down, before teamfights make his range matter more than your dueling.

edits.before: His R (Slicing Maelstrom) AOE stun plus passive move speed lets him peel you off and reset spacing in 5v5s, so he refuses the 1v1 you're built to win and reclaims the lane long-term.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom (R) is a flat 120s at every rank; its AoE stun plus passive move speed resets spacing in 5v5s, so he refuses the 1v1 you are built to win and reclaims the lane.
